spec.obtain: No credential. Launch a debuggable Chrome FIRST (non-admin): on Windows/WSL run `& "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe" --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=$env:TEMP\cdp "--remote-allow-origins=*"` and open your target site. WSL reaches Windows Chrome at 127.0.0.1:9222 under mirrored networking.

steps: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --browserUrl=http://127.0.0.1:9222
claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --browserUrl=http://127.0.0.1:9222
claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --browserUrl=http://127.0.0.1:9222

gotchas: Tools from a newly-added MCP load on the NEXT Claude Code session (or `claude --continue`), not mid-session.
Run Chrome NON-admin; an elevated instance often won't open a window.
Capture any secret from DevTools to a FILE (responseFilePath / evaluate filePath), never inline to the chat.

verify.cmd: claude mcp get chrome-devtools >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK
